responsibility: Introduces the PowerPC 476-specific command-line option table entry for preserving the core’s link stack. The file binds -mpreserve-link-stack to the rs6000_link_stack target variable, making the option visible to GCC’s option machinery and documenting the code-generation behavior of matching blr with GOT-access branches on this processor.
same_name_distinction: This is the 476 option-definition file: it adds the -mpreserve-link-stack switch and binds it to rs6000_link_stack. Unlike 476.h, it does not implement the target hook overrides that use that variable, and unlike 476.md, it contains no scheduling model.
